# `silk/platform/windows/input`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Raw-byte reads from the Windows standard-input handle.

## When to use
`OsStandardInput` uses `WindowsInput.read` beneath the portable `StandardInput` service.
Console reads use the active console input code page. Redirected files and pipes preserve bytes.
